subject: 兴城古城 · 东门春和门城楼与瓮城正面（城外视角）
name: 兴城古城
sub: 春和门 · 东门城楼与瓮城
yearNote: 城墙始建于明宣德三年（1428），宣德五年（1430）竣工，年份取城墙始建。四座城门楼现存木构是否原构、何时修复或重建未查到（辽宁文旅页只记形制），图版按2011年实拍现状绘制，不断言城楼年代。
coordinate_source: Wikidata Q20687924（兴城古城 Xingcheng Old Town）P625 坐标 40.62083, 120.7075（精度1″），古城中心近似点，非春和门实测；地图显示点新建 ln_xingcheng（兴城市代表点，Wikidata Q1375638：40.61886, 120.7205）。
lede: 明宣德三年（1428）筑成的宁远卫城，周长三千二百余米的砖包城墙至今四面完整，是中国保存最好的明代城池之一。四门之外各围一圈半圆瓮城，门上起两层歇山城楼。这里画的是东门春和门：瓮城两翼夹着券洞，城楼在正中探出重檐。
facts: 年代：明宣德三年（1428）由辽东总兵巫凯等奏请修筑，宣德五年竣工；城墙1988年列第三批国保“兴城城墙”，2006年第六批合并为“兴城古城”。
形制：城墙南北821米、东西816米，周长3274米，高8.5—9.6米；四门外皆筑半圆瓮城，门楼为五开间两层、重檐回廊歇山顶，钟鼓楼在城中心。
图版：取2011年自城外正对东门的实拍，保留瓮城两翼、券洞与两层城楼；摊贩、横幅、路牌、车辆去除，城楼五间按照片与官方记载核对。
caption: 兴城古城 · 春和门城楼与瓮城
明 · 1428
structure_checkpoints: 瓮城：画面左右各一段高大的灰砖城墙斜向前伸（瓮城两翼），墙顶有雉堞与收分；两翼之间露出主城门墙面。
券洞：主城门为单孔砖券门，洞口上方墙体平整，墙顶一道女墙；券洞内可见城内街道（图版留白）。
城楼：两层楼阁——下层为开敞回廊（一排方柱、中央一组槛窗），上层封闭殿身、正面一排槛窗；下层柱廊上出一道腰檐，上层顶为歇山顶，正脊两端有吻、垂脊有走兽。2011年照片各层正面约五间，与辽宁文旅“五开间两层楼阁，重檐回廊歇山顶”一致，按五开间绘。
屋面：灰色筒瓦，无琉璃；两道檐口平直、角部略翘，角端悬风铎。
地面：画面下缘只用几条短地线；瓮城内外的摊位、人车、灯柱、电线不画。北门威远门（2010年照片）下层另有一圈低檐，与东门不同，以东门照片为准。
material_observations: 城墙与瓮城为青灰色大砖包砌、灰浆勾缝，墙面平整略有风化；城楼木构为深褐近黑色，槛窗为暗色木格；屋面灰色筒瓦、灰色脊饰；无彩画与琉璃。
author: Pechorin04

additional_sources.author: 猫猫的日记本
additional_sources.role: 北门威远门城楼侧后方视角（2010），核对两层楼阁、回廊柱、歇山屋面与马道；该楼下层另有一圈低檐，与东门不完全相同，不作东门几何依据。

source_note: 主图为 Pechorin04 2011 年 8 月自城外正对东门春和门的实拍（CC BY-SA 3.0），瓮城两翼、券洞与两层城楼完整；画面下部有摊贩、横幅与车辆，需去除。补充图为猫猫的日记本 2010 年北门威远门侧后方实拍（CC BY-SA 3.0），只用于核对楼阁构造。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK line drawing on a perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) background. Use confident fine contours and a few finer internal structural lines. All unmarked surfaces inside and outside the drawing remain pure white; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, broad grey shading, crosshatching, pencil grain, paper texture, gradient, color, gold, halo, cast shadow or checkerboard. The white canvas will be removed later by a script; draw only the ink strokes and keep all other regions uniformly white.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.

SUBJECT: the East Gate (Chunhe Gate, 春和门) of Xingcheng old city, Liaoning, seen straight on from outside the city as in Image 2 (2011 photo). Composition from left to right: the left wing of the semicircular barbican wall (grey brick, battlemented top, slightly battered) projecting toward the viewer, the central gate wall with ONE round-arched gateway, and the right barbican wing. On top of the gate wall stands a TWO-STOREY gate tower: a lower open gallery storey with a row of square timber posts (five bays across the front, one central lattice window group), a projecting lower eave, an enclosed upper storey with a row of lattice windows, and a hip-and-gable top roof with ridge-end ornaments and small ridge beasts; grey tube tiles, no glazing, bells at the eave corners. Image 3 (north gate, oblique) is only for understanding the tower construction – do not copy its extra lower eave. Remove vendors, umbrellas, banners, flags, road signs, cars, people, lamp posts, wires, the surveillance camera and the trees. Landscape 1536×1024, the whole barbican-plus-tower group about 82% of the width, tower ridge and wall base uncut.
Orientation: landscape 1536×1024.
